exposure: Use of internet for health information seeking
outcome: Frequency of internet use for health information
Discussion of internet findings with physicians
Influence of internet information on delivery route
cohort: 302 pregnant women in the immediate postpartum period
finding: Pregnant women frequently use the internet to search for health-related information and often discuss their findings with physicians, but this does not appear to impact their chosen delivery route.
mod_finding: Internet use for health information did not affect the delivery route chosen by pregnant women.
